keyEvents.text: Gady Beyuku (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Arne Engels (West Ham United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half begins Blackburn Rovers 0, West Ham United 0.

Goal! Blackburn Rovers 1, West Ham United 0. Andri Gudjohnsen (Blackburn Rovers) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jayden Fevrier with a cross following a fast break.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, West Ham United. Manor Solomon replaces Edvin Austbø.
Substitution, West Ham United. Valentín Castellanos replaces Mohamadou Kanté.
Kristi Montgomery (Blackburn Rovers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Augustus Kargbo replaces Jayden Fevrier.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Yuki Ohashi replaces Andri Gudjohnsen.
Goal! Blackburn Rovers 2, West Ham United 0. Oladapo Afolayan (Blackburn Rovers) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Yuki Ohashi.
Maximilian Kilman (West Ham United) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, West Ham United. Tomás Soucek replaces Joël Veltman.
Substitution, West Ham United. Lewis Orford replaces Divine Mukasa.
Goal! Blackburn Rovers 2, West Ham United 1. Joël Piroe (West Ham United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Valentín Castellanos with a cross.
Substitution, Blackburn Rovers. Moussa Baradji replaces Kristi Montgomery.
